reply.text:
This is not a training question, and I'm not going to treat it like one. What you just wrote, "I don't want to live anymore," tells me you may be in serious pain right now, and I want you to get support from a real person today.

If you are thinking about ending your life or might act on it, please contact emergency services now (112 in Germany, or your local number), or go to the nearest emergency room. If you can, reach out to someone you trust and tell them what you just told me, and don't stay alone with it. In Germany you can also call the Telefonseelsorge at 0800 111 0 111 or 0800 111 0 222, any time, free, and they speak German. If you're elsewhere, tell me where and I'll help you find the right number.

I'm a strength coach, so I can't be the one who helps you through this, but I'd rather you talk to someone who can. Are you safe right now?
